items.problem_plain: When you type Heizkosten per tenant after a Zwischenablesung, the empty days between two tenants get a share worked out simply by days, and the screen calls it 'measured'. Example WHG 516 2025: Heizkosten 1.000 €, typed 700 € + 280 €. The Leerstand line says 'consumption 41,10 € (measured) · 72,66 € on you'. Only 20,00 € is actually left over, so 51,56 € on you is right. Letters are not affected.
items.fix_plain: Once every tenant's amount is typed, the empty days carry exactly what is left over. If there are several empty spans or Pauschal stays, they share it by days. The word '(measured)' only appears for such a remainder or a meter split. While one amount is still missing, the estimate by days is labelled '(by days)'.

It returns null while one amount is missing. In _srSpanShare, branch pos.split === 'mieter': if rest !== null, cons += rest × days / freeDays, where freeDays = days of the Pauschal stays (_srStays with note 'Pauschal') + all vacancy days. If rest === null, cons += unit × days/perDays and byDays = true. In the Verbrauch branch, byDays = true when sp.how !== 'meter' and a consumption share is added. Return { …, byDays }. The _srNkTens Leerstand line prints '(by days)' when o.byDays, else '(measured)'.

review.workflow:
THE OWNER'S NK WORKFLOW AFTER K1 + K2 (iPhone, plain steps; [n] = K2 item that shapes the step)

A. RENTALS: once a year per apartment (Settlements › Rentals › year › apartment card)
1. Wait for the Jahresabrechnung. The card's Jahresabrechnung tile says 'expected Dezember 2026'. When the tenant Frist is less than 60 days away and it is still missing, the tile turns red: 'not in yet · Frist soon · ask HV'. Tap 'ask HV' to get the ready-made mail. The word 'overdue' appears only once the HV is really late (15 days after the month it usually sends). The card, the Jahresabrechnungen list, the ring and the Dashboard all use the same word [48]. A WEG result typed in the old way counts as 'in' [50].
2. Enter the Jahresabrechnung (tap the tile):
   - Step 1: 'Received on'.
   - Step 2: the costs. Until you tap Mark complete, last year's rows stay offered empty, so a half-done entry never loses them [55]. A name picked from the list (CO₂ landlord share, Heizkosten) counts correctly at once [24].
   - The WEG result (Nachzahlung / Guthaben / balanced) and its due date.
   - Mark complete.
3. WEG money. The tile says 'you pay 120,00 € · not paid yet'. Tap Paid or Received with the date, and Controlling books it once. History uses the same words [47]. If you later correct the result to the other direction, the tile says 'not received yet' again, and one tap on Received turns the old booking around [31].
4. NK window (NK-Abrechnung tile):
   - The costs in the NK. Grundsteuer comes in by itself; a Grundsteuer you type replaces it at once and stays editable [62].
   - 'Who carries it': the tenants, plus the empty days that stay with you ('Leerstand · on you'). These always use the period each tenant is billed for [22]. The word '(measured)' appears only when the share really is measured, otherwise '(by days)' [23].
5. Tenant window (tap the tenant). It has these sections:
   - Period, Costs, Calculation.
   - Letter details: address, letter date (today unless you type another one [36]), pay within, and the tenant IBAN when money goes back (K1).
   - A yellow 'needs: …' chip names the section to fill [60].
   - Open letter (PDF) to check it. The Zeitraum box says 'Abrechnungsjahr 2025', or 'Abrechnungszeitraum 01.07.2025–30.06.2026' for a period that is not a calendar year [39]. The Vorauszahlungen table has one row per month [41]. A Kaution part held for the NK is already offset (K1).
6. Mark as sent. The letter is archived with today's date and the due date. Controlling shows the result as an open Soll that is not counted yet. From then on:
   - The window shows that letter's figures ('Costs · as sent').
   - Open letter (PDF) opens the archived copy [38].
   - To send a corrected letter: 'undo' on the Letter step → 'Back to open' [61].
7. Money step, in the same window. It names the one real bank transfer: 'Lena pays you 180,00 €' or 'You pay back 620,00 €'. With a held Kaution it shows the rest that really moves (K1). Date and amount are prefilled. Tap Received or Paid back, and Controlling books one line in that month. 'undo' here and clearing the Ist in Controlling do the same thing: the line goes back to 'sent · waiting for the money' everywhere, the tenant card included [30].
8. Skip. The tenant line says 'skipped'. The card tile, the top tile and the Dashboard leave it out [45]. The NK-Abrechnungen sheet lists it under Settled and lists waiting tenants under 'Not yet', so its count matches the ring [49].
9. Done. The card folds to 'all settled'. Controlling › Abrechnungen has the Soll from sending and the Ist from Received / Paid back. A Kaution never counts.

B. CASA CASTEL (Settlements › Casa Castel › year)
1. Enter each Versorger bill. The Casa Jahresabrechnungen tile and the Dashboard show the same figure [51].
2. When the bills are in, lock the house costs. You can add a tenant who is not in the app, or remove one, only while the house costs are unlocked; Remove follows the same rule as Add [53].
3. Room cards list each tenant's NK line. A tenant who only changes rent type is not 'moved out' and keeps the house address [42].
4. Tenant sheet:
   - Calculation ('Lived here … 1 month' [34]).
   - Letter details: Address, IBAN when money goes back, Pay within, Belegliste on/off. The 'Former tenant' switch is gone [43].
   - Open letter (PDF): page 1 is the letter, page 2 the Belegliste, which says 'auf Seite 1' [32]. A part-year tenant's Zeitraum names the billing year [33]. The Kaution text is one paragraph, and the closing block is never split [35].
5. Mark as sent → archived. Later, 'Open letter (PDF)' opens that copy, or redraws it with the date and due date it was sent with [37].
6. Money step → Received / Paid back → Controlling books it once. 'undo' works the same way for hand-added tenants [54].
7. From the Casa app's tenant card: the NK line shows the Kalt + NK part of the year. 'Open NK-Abrechnung' opens exactly that sheet, and Skip skips exactly that line [52, 56].

C. OWN NK ON THE DASHBOARD (older years, tenants not in the app)
1. Dashboard › NK-Abrechnung erstellen › Who & when. Pick a tenant and the lived days are filled in; there is no Former switch [44]. Until a name is there, the result reads 'The tenant pays you …' [64].
2. Costs (split by days for a part-year tenant, K1) and NK paid. Only the lived months are shown and counted, with a part month marked '15/30 Tage' in the letter [40].
3. Preview PDF → Mark as sent. It is saved for the tenant's own days: Controlling shows 'NK 16.09.2025–31.12.2025 · Eva Wolf', and the Rentals line turns 'sent' [29]. The money then works as in A7.
4. Drafts list: 'Name · Property · NK 01.07.2024–30.06.2025' [65]. It is up to date after you come back to the app [58].
5. Overview. Needs you shows e.g. 'Jahresabrechnung not in yet · Rentals · Rheinblick 3 · Frist soon'. A skipped Casa NK shows 'skipped' [46].

D. KAUTION AT MOVE-OUT (K1: Tenants › tenant › Kaution card)
1. Settle in one form: Kept · other reasons (with a reason), Kept · for NK-Abrechnung, Refund to tenant, Settled on. The card then says 'Settled · 300 € held for NK'. Nothing goes to Controlling.
2. Rent kept from the Kaution: Controlling Income, as received rent. Damage kept: Maintenance › Who pays › Schaden › Direct.
3. The move-out year's NK letter takes the 300 € by itself and names the one transfer that is left. The Money step reads e.g. 'You pay back 100,00 €', and Controlling books +200 once. The Casa letter stays 2 pages [35], and a sent line keeps its figures [38].
4. If no NK is sent within 12 months: add the held part to the refund on the card.

SETTINGS: 'Period starts on' offers only days that exist (February 01–28) [57].

HOW LONG: about 23.5 h of work, including tests and an independent check per package. With four builders working in parallel after K1 is merged, it takes about 12.5 h elapsed: the Rentals package is the longest at 9.5 h, then 3 h of integration.
ux_rules: One word per state, the same on the Rentals card, lists, ring, History, the Casa tab, the Dashboard and the tenant cards. Jahresabrechnung: 'expected' → 'Frist soon' (red: missing, and the tenant Frist is 60 days or less away) → 'overdue' (only 15 days after the month the HV usually sends) → 'to enter' → 'not paid yet' / 'not received yet' → 'paid' / 'received' / 'settled'. Tenant NK: 'waiting' (costs not in yet) → 'to send' → 'sent' → 'settled' / 'skipped'. Money: 'pays you' / 'gets … back' / 'you pay back' / 'balanced'. Existing difference that stays: Casa room lines may say 'paid' / 'returned' as the done state.
Every view reads a status from the same function: card, list, ring, History, Dashboard and tenant card can never disagree (e.g. items 45, 46, 47, 48, 49, 50, 52).

One place per action: Jahresabrechnung window = HV letter and WEG result. NK window = costs and 'Who carries it'. Tenant window / sheet = letter (Mark as sent, undo) and money (Received / Paid back, undo). Kaution card = the Kaution. Clearing an Ist in Controlling does exactly what undo does. A link from a tenant card opens the exact sheet.

No hidden levels and no silent freezing: a value is stored only when the owner types something different from the suggestion. Opening a PDF, editing another field or choosing an option never fixes a date, address or Anlage.

A sent letter is fixed: the screen ('… as sent'), 'Open letter (PDF)', History and Controlling all show the letter the tenant got, with the same date, due date and figures. The archived copy comes first; a redraw uses the stored date and due date. Corrections go only through undo on the Letter step.
No new messages, warnings, hints, buttons or levels; existing toasts may only be reworded. A control that does nothing is removed, not explained (e.g. 'Former tenant', 'from Rentals').
English on screen, German only in letters. Undo: 'Back to open?' / 'Back to open'. Failures: 'Could not save — …' / 'Could not undo — …' / 'Please run the Settlements SQL in Supabase first'.

Period labels on screen: always 'NK dd.mm.yyyy–dd.mm.yyyy', never a slash and never 'NK 2025' (the tenant-card pill 'NK 2025 open' stays, as the owner chose). Letters: 'Abrechnungsjahr 2025' for 01.01.–31.12., otherwise 'Abrechnungszeitraum 01.07.2025–30.06.2026'. The same rule applies in the Rentals, Casa and own-NK letters.
Proper singular and plural: '1 Monat' / '1 month' / '1 day' / '1 tenant', and plural otherwise; never '(s)'.
Money colours stay as they are: green = to you, red = out, beige = nothing yet. Red also marks 'Frist soon' and 'overdue'.
Typing is never interrupted: totals follow at once, and lists redraw when the field is left.
Kaution (R1–R3, K1): never counted in Controlling; no 'with the rent' or 'via Kaution' choice; the kept part counts once, at the Money step that names the one real bank transfer.
iPhone: no new elements. A letter stays letter + Belegliste (2 pages); if a letter grows, its closing block (hints, greeting, signature, Anlage) moves as one piece with the correct 'Seite n'.
Old stored data stays as stored and no SQL is needed. A wrong status left by old data is checked, not handed to the owner as a rule to remember.
